CyclePhases.4: Ukwezi kwawe kw’imihango kugizwe n’ibihe bitandukanye, buri kimwe gifise uruhara rw’ingenzi mu buringanire bwa hormone zawe no mu buzima bwawe.
CyclePhases.8: Igituma gusobanukirwa ukwezi kwawe ari ngombwa
CyclePhases.10: Ukwezi kwawe kuraca kugabanywa mu bihe bine nyamukuru. Uburebure bwavyo burashobora gutandukana ku muntu ku wundi: umubiri wose ufise umuvuduko wawo.
CyclePhases.20: Umugore wese ari wenyine: itegereze umubiri wawe ukamenya umuvuduko wawe.
CyclePhases.21: Impinduka za hormone zishobora kugira ingaruka ku mbaraga zawe, ku mutima wawe, ku bitiro no ku bimenyetso bimwebimwe vy’umubiri mu gihe c’ukwezi.
CyclePhases.23: Imbaraga zawe zishobora kuba nkeya kandi umubiri wawe ukaba ukeneye kuruhuka cane.
CyclePhases.25: Imbaraga ziriyongera buhorobuhoro kandi ushobora kwumva ufise imbaraga nyinshi.
CyclePhases.27: Abagore bamwebamwe bumva bafise imbaraga, ubushake no kwizera vyinshi.
CyclePhases.29: Kunanirwa, kubyimba inda, canke impinduka z’umutima bishobora kugaragara.
CyclePhases.31: Nta buryo bumwe gusa bwo kubaho buri gihe. Ivyo wumva wewe bigumya kuba umuyobozi mwiza.
CyclePhases.32: Kumenya neza ukwezi kwawe bishobora kugufasha guteganya ibihe bimwebimwe no gusobanukirwa impinduka ubona buri musi.
CyclePhases.34: Guteganya imihango yawe n’ibihe vyayo bitandukanye
CyclePhases.36: Guhuza ibikorwa vyawe n’urugero rw’imbaraga zawe
CyclePhases.37: Kuvugurura gukurikirana kwawe kwa buri musi
CyclePhases.38: Dore ibisubizo bikeya ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa ku bihe bitandukanye vy’ukwezi.
CyclePhases.39: Biraciye ngo ukwezi kwanje ntikumare iminsi 28 yuzuye?
CyclePhases.40: Ego. Uburebure bw’ukwezi bushobora gutandukana ku muntu ku wundi, no kuri uwo muntu gake gake kuva mu kwezi ku kundi.
CyclePhases.41: Ovulation iba buri gihe ku musi wa 14?
CyclePhases.42: Oya. Umusi wa 14 ni ikigereranyo gikunze gukoreshwa ku kwezi kw’iminsi 28, ariko ovulation ishobora kuba imbere canke inyuma.
CyclePhases.43: Kubera iki ibimenyetso vyanje bihinduka bitewe n’igihe?
CyclePhases.44: Impinduka za hormone mu gihe c’ukwezi zishobora kugira ingaruka ku mbaraga, ku mutima, ku bitiro no ku bimenyetso bimwebimwe vy’umubiri.
CyclePhases.46: Ego. Kubyandika buri gihe bishobora kugufasha kumenya uko ukwawe kumera no gusobanukirwa neza umuvuduko wawe.
CyclePhases.48: Uko urushiriza kwitegereza ukwezi kwawe, ni ko urushiriza gusobanukirwa ivyo bisanzwe kuri wewe.

CycleVitalSign.6: Igituma rimwe na rimwe ukwezi kwitwa “ikimenyetso ca gatanu c’ubuzima”.
CycleVitalSign.12: Gukurikirana ukwezi kwawe kugira wimenye neza
CycleVitalSign.30: Ukwezi kw’imihango kugirwa n’ibikorwa vya hormone z’umubiri mu kwezi kwose. Kwiga kukwitegereza bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza uko umubiri wawe ukora, udakeneye gusesengura vyose mu buryo burambuye.
CycleVitalSign.32: Nta kwezi kumwe kwuzuye: umubiri wose ufise umuvuduko wawo, kandi uwo muvuduko ushobora no gutandukana gake kuva mu kwezi ku kundi. Ukwezi kuraba gusanzwe iyo kumara hagati y’iminsi 21 na 35, kandi imihango ikunze kumara iminsi 3 kugeza kuri 7.
CycleVitalSign.33: Ivyo bipimo ni ibigereranyo: impinduka nkeya ziguma ari ibisanzwe rwose, cane cane nyuma yo kuvyiruka, nyuma yo kubyara, canke menopause yegereje.
CycleVitalSign.34: Impinduka zimwezimwe zikwiye kwitegerezwa neza kuruta, nk’izi:
CycleVitalSign.36: Imihango irushiriza cane gusanzwe kuba myinshi
CycleVitalSign.40: Impinduka ikomeye isubira mu mezi menshi
CycleVitalSign.41: Ukwezi kumwe gusa kudasanzwe ntivyerekana mu buryo bwikora ikibazo c’ubuzima: umubiri ushobora kwakira mu gihe gito ibintu vyinshi bitandukanye.
CycleVitalSign.42: Izo mpinduka rimwe na rimwe zishobora kuba zifitaniye isano n’ibintu bitandukanye, ata kuba ikibazo ngo gikwiye.
CycleVitalSign.43: Ivyo ni zimwe mu mpamvu zishoboka mu zindi: ntizisubira mu cumbi inama z’umuganga.
CycleVitalSign.45: Kwandika amatariki yawe, amaraso, canke uko wiyumva bigufasha kumenya ingeso zawe, ukwezi ku kundi.
CycleVitalSign.46: Umusi wa mbere w’imihango yawe, uburebure bwayo, amaraso, ububabare, umutima, imbaraga, canke ibisohoka mu gitsina ni vyose ushobora kwandika uko igihe kigenda. Intego si ugereranya ukwezi kwawe n’ukw’undi, ahubwo ni ukurushiriza kumenya ivyo bisanzwe kuri wewe, n’ivyo bitandukanye.
CycleVitalSign.47: Ni ibisanzwe rwose kugira ibibazo ku kwezi kwawe. Gusaba inama y’umuganga bishobora gufasha mu bihe bimwebimwe, nk’ibi:
CycleVitalSign.54: Kuvugana n’umuganga bishobora kugutuza canke, nibiba ngombwa, kukuronsa ubufasha bukwiye — si impamvu yo guhagarika umutima ubwayo.
CycleVitalSign.55: Ukwezi ntikuba gukeneye kuba gufise uburinganire bwuzuye ngo kube gusanzwe. Kumenya umuvuduko wawe usanzwe akenshi bifasha kuruta kurondera uburebure bwiza.
CycleVitalSign.56: Ukwezi kwawe kw’imihango ni kimwe mu bimenyetso vyinshi vy’ubuzima bwawe. Kukukurikirana buri gihe bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa umubiri wawe n’uko igihe kigenda, kubona impinduka zikwiye kwitonderwa by’umwihariko.
CycleVitalSign.57: Ukwezi kwawe, ikimenyetso gihambaye c’ubuzima — AWA

ExerciseCycleSupport.6: Igituma imyitozo y’umubiri ya buri gihe ishobora gushigikira uburinganire bw’ukwezi kwawe, ubwoko bw’ukwimuka bwo gutoranya, n’uburyo bwo guhuza umuvuduko wawe nta gitutu canke icaha.
ExerciseCycleSupport.7: Si ugukora cane, ahubwo ni ukwimuka mu buryo bukubereye kandi ushobora kugumana uko igihe kigenda.
ExerciseCycleSupport.9: Igituma kwimuka bishobora gushigikira ukwezi kwawe
ExerciseCycleSupport.10: Ni ibihe byiza ku kwezi kwawe?
ExerciseCycleSupport.18: Imyitozo y’umubiri ya buri gihe igira ingaruka ku bice vyinshi vy’umubiri, harimwo ivyifatanya mu kuringaniza hormone no mu mikorere y’ukwezi kw’imihango. Ikora cane ku kwumva insulin, ku gucunga guhagarika umutima, no ku bwiza bw’ibitiro — ibintu bitatu bifitaniye isano n’uburinganire bwa hormone.
ExerciseCycleSupport.19: Kwimuka buri gihe ntibyemeza ukwezi “kuzuye”, ariko ni kimwe mu bintu bishigikira ubuzima bwiza muri rusangi, ingaruka zabwo zishobora kugaragara mu kwezi ku bagore bamwebamwe.
ExerciseCycleSupport.21: Isano iri hagati y’imyitozo y’umubiri n’ukwezi ni iy’umuntu ku giti ciwe: abagore bamwebamwe babona ingaruka zigaragara, abandi ntibazibone cane. Uko vyoba vyifashe vyose, ikiguma ari ingeso nziza.
ExerciseCycleSupport.22: Igikorwa cya buri gihe gishobora gufasha mu buryo butandukanye, ariko izo ngaruka ntizemezwa kandi ntizingana kuri bose:
ExerciseCycleSupport.29: Gufasha, ku bagore bamwebamwe, ukwezi kuba gufise uburinganire bwiza
ExerciseCycleSupport.30: Ivyo byiza biriyongera buhorobuhoro: si ingaruka y’ako kanya nyuma y’igikorwa kimwe.
ExerciseCycleSupport.31: Nta gikorwa “ciza” kuruta ikindi: igikora cane ni icyo ukunda gukora buri gihe.
ExerciseCycleSupport.38: Nta tegeko rimwe kuri bose: ikiruta ni uburinganire kuruta ubuhanga. Gushira ibihe bigufi vyo kwimuka mu musi wawe (kugenda n’amaguru, kuzamuka ingazi, kurambura umubiri) bibara nk’imyitozo yateguwe.
ExerciseCycleSupport.39: Urugero rukwiye rw’imbaraga ruterwa n’urugero rw’ubuzima bw’umubiri wawe, ubuzima bwawe, imbaraga zawe muri ico gihe, n’intego zawe bwite: ikibereye umwe ntikibera mu buryo bwikora undi.
ExerciseCycleSupport.41: Ibihe bitatu bigufi mu cumweru, bigumwa uko igihe kigenda, akenshi bifasha kuruta intego nini yaretswe nyuma y’iminsi mikeya.
ExerciseCycleSupport.42: Imbaraga n’uko umubiri wiyumva bishobora gutandukana mu gihe c’ukwezi. Guhindura urugero rw’igikorwa bitewe n’uko wiyumva ni ibisanzwe rwose.
ExerciseCycleSupport.43: Mu mihango yawe: kwimuka gake nibiba bikubereye
ExerciseCycleSupport.44: Nyuma y’imihango yawe: kwiyongera buhorobuhoro nimba imbaraga zawe zibikwemerera
ExerciseCycleSupport.45: Hafi ya ovulation: gumana igikorwa gisanzwe bitewe n’uko wiyumva
ExerciseCycleSupport.46: Imbere y’imihango yawe: hitamwo kwimuka kworoshe, ukaruhuka nibiba ngombwa
ExerciseCycleSupport.47: Ivyo si amategeko akomeye y’umubiri: umugore wese abaho ukwezi kwiwe mu buryo bwiwe, kandi ivyo bigereranyo ni ibimenyetso, si ibigomba.
ExerciseCycleSupport.48: Ku bagore bafise PCOS, imyitozo y’umubiri ya buri gihe irashobora gufasha cane: ishigikira kwumva insulin, ikintu gikunze guhungabana muri ibyo bihe, kandi ishobora gufasha uburinganire bwa metabolisme na hormone mu gihe kirekire.
ExerciseCycleSupport.50: Si umuti, ahubwo ni ubufasha bwunganira ubuvuzi muri rusangi, bukwiye guhuzwa n’umuganga.
ExerciseCycleSupport.51: Ivyizerwa vyibeshya canke ingeso zimwezimwe zishobora kuba mbi kuruta nziza:
ExerciseCycleSupport.53: Gutekereza ko imyitozo ikomeye gusa ari yo ifasha
ExerciseCycleSupport.54: Gukora imyitozo gusa ufise intego yo kunanuka
ExerciseCycleSupport.56: Kwumva ufise icaha nyuma yo kureka igikorwa
ExerciseCycleSupport.57: Mu bihe bimwebimwe, inama y’umuganga irafasha cane imbere yo gusubira canke guhuza imyitozo y’umubiri:
ExerciseCycleSupport.63: Gusubira ku gikorwa nyuma y’inda canke yo kubyara
ExerciseCycleSupport.64: Ikibazo cose aho igikorwa cabujijwe n’abaganga
ExerciseCycleSupport.66: Kwimuka ntibikenera kuba bikomeye canke bizuye kugira bifashe. Igikorwa gihoraho, gishimisha kandi gishobora kugumwa gishobora gushigikira ubuzima bwawe muri rusangi no gufasha, ku bagore bamwebamwe, gucunga neza ukwezi.
ExerciseCycleSupport.68: Iyi nkuru ni iyo kumenyesha muri rusangi kandi ntisubira mu cumbi inama z’umuganga. Huza buri gihe imyitozo y’umubiri n’ibihe vyawe bwite, ukaba usaba inama umuganga nimba ufise ugukeka.
ExerciseCycleSupport.69: Kwimuka kugira ushigikire ukwezi kwawe — AWA

FastingQadaa.6: Ukuntu n’igihe co gusubiza iminsi y’isawm yasibye, ku muvuduko wawe ata caha.
FastingQadaa.8: Ivyo ni ivyo kwigisha gusa. Ibibazo vy’idini bikwiye kwemezwa n’abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa canke imyanzuro y’idini yihariye.
FastingQadaa.11: Igihe gisanzwe: imbere ya Ramadan ikurikira
FastingQadaa.14: Qadaa ivuga gusubiza, mu gihe cakurikiye, iminsi y’isawm yasibye muri Ramadan — cane cane kubera imihango. Iyo minsi igomba gusubizwa kuko isawm ya Ramadan iguma ari inkingi y’ukwezi, kandi iminsi yahagaritswe kubera imihango ibarwa nk’ideni, bitari ikosa ryawe.
FastingQadaa.15: Gusubiza bisanzwe bishobora gutangura Ramadan ikimara kurangira, ibihe vyawe bimaze kubikwemerera. Ushobora gutunganya iyo minsi ku muvuduko wawe: bamwebamwe bahitamwo kuyihurira hamwe nyuma ya Ramadan, abandi bakayigabura buhorobuhoro mu mezi akurikira.
FastingQadaa.17: Gusubiza iminsi ikurikirana canke kuyigabura bishobora kubonwa mu buryo butandukanye bitewe n’ishuri ry’amategeko y’idini; nta buryo na bumwe bwerekanwa hano nk’ubwo bwonyine bwemewe.
FastingQadaa.18: Andika umubare wose w’iminsi yo gusubiza Ramadan ikimara kurangira
FastingQadaa.19: Hitamwo uburyo bworoshe: kalendari, porogaramu, agatabo
FastingQadaa.20: Raba buri musi nyuma y’uko usubijwe
FastingQadaa.21: Urugero, umuntu afise iminsi 6 yo gusubiza ashobora guhitamwo kuba imbwa umusi umwe mu cumweru mu byumweru bitandatu, canke kuyihurira mu gihe kimwe nimba bimubereye.
FastingQadaa.22: Biramenyerewe kugerageza gusubiza iminsi yasibye imbere ya Ramadan ikurikira. Iyi ngeso si itegeko mu bihe vyose, ariko yorohereza gutunganya kandi ikirinda kwegeranya iminsi myinshi isigaye.
FastingQadaa.24: Kugabura iminsi yo gusubiza bitewe na gahunda yawe bigufasha gukomeza utuje, nta gitutu.
FastingQadaa.25: Gutegura imbere bifasha kwirinda guhagarika umutima mu minota ya nyuma. Inama yoroshe ni ukubara iminsi isigaye imbere ya Ramadan ikurikira, ukagabura iminsi yo gusubiza mu byumweru canke amezi asigaye.
FastingQadaa.27: Niba impamvu irambye canke isubira ibuza kuba imbwa (indwara imara igihe kirekire, nk’urugero), ibihe bishobora kuba bifise ikindi giti c’amategeko; ni vyiza cane rero kubiganirako n’umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi.
FastingQadaa.29: Amategeko nyayo mu gihe igihe cirengeye ashobora gutandukana bitewe n’ukuntu bisobanurwa. Ku kibazo cose kigoye, ibitekerezo vy’umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi biguma ari inkomoko.
FastingQadaa.30: Urugero, nimba Ramadan ikurikira itangura mu mezi 8 kandi hasigaye iminsi 6 yo gusubiza, ikishoboka ni ugutegura nk’umusi umwe mu kwezi, hamwe n’ukwishura ku bintu bitateganijwe.
FastingQadaa.31: Inda no konsa bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bushobozi bwo kuba imbwa, cane cane iyo isawm ishobora guteza akaga ku buzima bw’umubyeyi canke bw’umwana. Ubuzima bwiza bw’umubiri n’ubushobozi nyabwo bwo kuba imbwa ni ibintu vy’ingenzi vyo kwitaho.
FastingQadaa.33: Ivyo bihe bimenywa n’imigenzo y’idini nk’ibishobora gutuma umuntu adasabwa.
FastingQadaa.34: Ibitekerezo vy’idini ku isawm itakozwe mu gihe c’inda canke konsa birashobora gutandukana bitewe n’ishuri, cane cane ku kibazo co kumenya niba gusubiza gusa bihagije canke hariho n’ukwishura. Impamvu nyayo yo kutaba imbwa n’ibihe bwite bishobora kugira ingaruka ku gisubizo gikwiye.
FastingQadaa.36: Qadaa igufasha gusubiza utuje iminsi y’isawm yasibye, ku muvuduko wawe. Mu gihe c’ikibazo cihariye (igihe cirengeye, inda, konsa, inzitizi irambye), ibitekerezo vy’umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi biguma ari isoko nziza.
FastingQadaa.37: Kuba imbwa no kudasabwa: gusubiza (Qadaa) — AWA

FertilityWindow.6: Igituma iminsi iri hafi ya ovulation ari yo y’ingenzi cane mu gusama.
FertilityWindow.9: Igituma iyo minsi ari yo ngenzi cane
FertilityWindow.12: Igihe c’uburumbuke ni igice c’ukwezi kwawe gishobora gusamamwo. Kimara hafi iminsi 6: iminsi 5 imbere ya ovulation, hamwe n’umusi wa ovulation ubwawo.
FertilityWindow.14: Ukwezi kwose kuratandukanye: igihe c’uburumbuke ntikiba ku musi umwe wa kalendari buri kwezi.
FertilityWindow.15: Intanga zishobora kubaho gushika ku minsi 5 mu mubiri w’umugore, bigatuma igihe cashobora gusamamwo kiba kinini. Igi ryo rigumya gushobora gusamwa hafi amasaha 24 gusa nyuma yo gusohoka.
FertilityWindow.16: Urugero, imibonano mpuzabitsina iba iminsi 3 imbere ya ovulation irashobora gutuma usama, naho iyo iba umusi ukurikira ovulation akenshi iba yatinze.
FertilityWindow.17: Ibimenyetso bimwebimwe, byitegerejwe hamwe, bifasha kumenya neza iki gihe:
FertilityWindow.23: Guhuza ibimenyetso bimwebimwe (ukwezi, mucus, impemba) bitanga ishusho yizewe kuruta y’igihe cawe c’uburumbuke kuruta ikimenyetso kimwe gusa.

FiqhWomenIntro.6: Incamake yuzuye y’ingingo nyamukuru zigarukwa muri fiqh y’abagore, hagati y’imigenzo y’idini n’ubuzima bwa buri musi.
FiqhWomenIntro.8: Ivyo ni ivyo kwigisha gusa. Ibibazo vy’idini bikwiye kwemezwa n’abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa canke imyanzuro y’idini yihariye.
FiqhWomenIntro.11: Kubera iki fiqh y’abagore ari ngombwa?
FiqhWomenIntro.13: Fiqh, ubuzima n’imigenzo ya buri musi
FiqhWomenIntro.15: Ni ryari dusaba inama umuntu abifitiye ubushobozi?
FiqhWomenIntro.17: Fiqh y’abagore ni umurima w’amategeko y’Isilamu (fiqh) wita ku bibazo vy’ukuri bijanye n’imibiri y’abagore no gusenga. Ifasha gusobanukirwa uko wahuza ubuzima bw’idini bwa buri musi n’ibihe bitandukanye vy’ukwezi k’umugore.
FiqhWomenIntro.22: Isengesho mu gihe c’imihango no nyuma yayo
FiqhWomenIntro.23: Isawm ya Ramadan n’iminsi yo gusubiza
FiqhWomenIntro.26: Ubuzima bwa buri musi n’imigenzo y’idini
FiqhWomenIntro.27: Fiqh ni umurima wo gusobanura amategeko: ibibazo bimwebimwe bifise ibitekerezo bitandukanye bitewe n’abahanga n’amashure, nta gitekerezo kimwe cose kiba gikomeye kuruta ibindi ubwacyo.
FiqhWomenIntro.28: Gusobanukirwa fiqh y’abagore bituma umuntu abaho imigenzo y’idini ye mu mahoro menshi, nta mpagarara, mu bihe umubiri unyuramwo mu ntambwe zihariye (imihango, inda, nyuma yo kubyara, menopause). Binafasha gutandukanya ivyo ari itegeko, ukudasabwa, canke inama yoroshe.
FiqhWomenIntro.30: Kumenya ivyo bitegerejwe muri buri ntambwe y’ukwezi bituma umuntu yegera ukwemera kwiwe yizeye kuruta.
FiqhWomenIntro.31: Madhab ivuga ishure ry’ibitekerezo vy’amategeko, ni ukuvuga uburyo butunganijwe abahanga bakoresha mu gusobanura inkomoko z’idini (Quran, Sunna, ukwumvikana, gutekereza) no gusubiza ibibazo vy’ukuri vya buri musi. Hariho amashure menshi, kubera ko abahanga batahoze bakurikiza uburyo bumwe canke ngo basobanure inyandiko zimwe mu buryo bumwe.
FiqhWomenIntro.32: Ni co gituma ibibazo bimwebimwe bijanye n’imihango, ubuhumanuro bw’idini, isengesho, canke isawm bishobora kugira ibitekerezo bitandukanye bitewe n’abahanga babajijwe. Itandukaniro ry’ibitekerezo ntirivuga ko igitekerezo kimwe “kitari co”: ryerekana uburyo butandukanye n’ukuntu inkomoko zimwe zisomwa.
FiqhWomenIntro.34: Biramenyerewe gukurikiza uburyo canke madhab isanzwe ikurikizwa mu muryango canke mu muryango w’umuntu.
FiqhWomenIntro.36: Iyo ikibazo cihariye c’idini kiguma kidasobanutse, ni ibisanzwe rwose gusaba igitekerezo c’umuhanga abifitiye ubushobozi.
FiqhWomenIntro.37: Amakuru y’ubuvuzi ku kwezi (uburebure, ibimenyetso, ibihe vya hormone) n’amategeko y’idini abikomokaho (ubuhumanuro, isengesho, isawm) bikurikiza ubuhanga bubiri butandukanye: kimwe kivuga ikintu c’ubuzima bw’umubiri, ikindi gishiraho ikibanza c’imigenzo y’umwuka. Bishobora kuzuzanya, ariko ntibikwiye kuvangwa.
FiqhWomenIntro.39: Gukurikirana ukwezi mu buvuzi n’ibimenyetso vy’idini bikomokaho buri kimwe gitanga ubumenyi bufasha.
FiqhWomenIntro.41: Umuganga ashobora gusubiza ibibazo vy’ubuvuzi; umuhanga abifitiye ubushobozi aguma ari inkomoko ku bibazo vy’idini.
FiqhWomenIntro.42: AWA ifasha abayikoresha gusobanukirwa ukwezi kwabo, hagati y’ubuzima n’imigenzo y’idini, mu buryo bwo kwigisha bwubaha itandukaniro riri hagati y’amashure.
FiqhWomenIntro.43: Gusobanukirwa ibitekerezo shingiro vya fiqh y’abagore
FiqhWomenIntro.44: Gusobanukirwa neza ukwezi kw’umuntu, mu buvuzi no mu idini
FiqhWomenIntro.45: Kumenya ibibazo bikeneye igitekerezo c’umuhanga abifitiye ubushobozi
FiqhWomenIntro.46: Kwisanga mu bitandukanye hagati ya madhahib nta mpagarara
FiqhWomenIntro.47: Kubona ibisobanuro vyo kwigisha bisobanutse kandi bidafata uruhande
FiqhWomenIntro.49: Gukurikira amakuru afasha imigenzo y’idini y’umuntu, nibiba ngombwa
FiqhWomenIntro.50: Gutegura ibibazo bihariye vyo kubaza umuhanga abifitiye ubushobozi
FiqhWomenIntro.52: AWA ni igikoresho co kwigisha no kumenyesha: ntisubira mu cumbi, mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose, igitekerezo c’umuhanga canke ubutegetsi bw’idini bubifitiye ubushobozi.
FiqhWomenIntro.53: Ibihe bimwebimwe bikwiye kugezwa mu buryo butaziguye ku muhanga wizeye, cane cane iyo:
FiqhWomenIntro.54: Ikibazo bwite kidahuye n’ikibazo gisanzwe (kuva amaraso bidasanzwe, gukeka kumara igihe kirekire...)
FiqhWomenIntro.55: Ibitekerezo bibiri canke vyinshi bisa nk’ibivuguruzanya kandi ntumenye ikiriwe gukurikiza
FiqhWomenIntro.56: Icemezo c’idini kigira ingaruka ikomeye ku migenzo yawe ya buri musi
FiqhWomenIntro.57: Wumva ukeneye ubuyobozi bubereye ibihe vyawe bwite
FiqhWomenIntro.59: Fiqh y’abagore ni umurima ubaho wo gusobanura, ufise ibitekerezo bitandukanye rimwe na rimwe hagati y’amashure. AWA igufasha gusobanukirwa ibishingiro no gutunganya ibibazo vyawe, ariko igitekerezo c’umuhanga abifitiye ubushobozi kiguma ari inkomoko ku cemezo cose cawe bwite c’idini.

FirstPeriod.6: Ivyo bisanzwe, ivyo bitanga ihumure, n’ivyo ukeneye kumenya.
FirstPeriod.8: Imihango yawe ya mbere iza ryari?
FirstPeriod.13: Imihango yawe ya mbere iza ryari?
FirstPeriod.14: Ikunze kuza hagati y’imyaka 10 na 15, hafi imyaka ibiri nyuma y’ibimenyetso vya mbere vyo kuvyiruka.
FirstPeriod.16: Mu ntango, ukwezi gushobora kuba kudahamye, kugufi canke kurekire. Umubiri wawe urafata igihe gusa co kubona umuvuduko wawo.
FirstPeriod.18: Imihango ikunze kumara iminsi 3 kugeza kuri 7. Amaraso n’ibara bishobora guhinduka kuva ku musi ku wundi.
FirstPeriod.20: Hindura ico wambaye ngo ukingire buri gihe, woge buhoro, uhitamwo imyambaro yorohera kugira wumve woroherewe.
FirstPeriod.22: Ushobora kuvugana na mama wawe, mushiki wawe, umuntu wo hafi yawe, umwarimu, canke umuganga wizeye.
FirstPeriod.24: Ukwezi kudahamye mu ntango ni ibisanzwe rwose. Umubiri wawe uracariga kwiga uko wabona umuvuduko wawo.
FirstPeriod.26: Umubiri wose ni uwihariye. Fata igihe cawe, wihangane, kandi ntutinye gusaba ubufasha umuntu wizeye.

FirstPeriodComing.1:
Nzamenya nte ko imihango yanje
ya mbere iri hafi?
FirstPeriodComing.6: Ibimenyetso bimwebimwe vy’ukuri bishobora kugufasha kumenya ko imihango yawe ya mbere iri hafi koko.
FirstPeriodComing.10: Ibisohoka mu gitsina canke amaraso y’imihango?
FirstPeriodComing.11: Ni ryari ukwiye kuvugana n’umuntu mukuru?
FirstPeriodComing.13: Ibisohoka byoroshe, bibonerana, akenshi bigaragara amezi make imbere.
FirstPeriodComing.15: Ikimenyetso gikunze kuboneka kigaragara akenshi imbere cane y’imihango yawe.
FirstPeriodComing.17: Ibimenyetso bito nk’ivyo bishobora kwerekana ko imihango yawe iri hafi.
FirstPeriodComing.18: Imbere y’uko imihango yawe ya mbere ije, biramenyerewe kubona ibisohoka byoroshe bisa n’umweru canke bikeya bisa n’umuhondo mu myambaro y’imbere. Ni ikintu gisanzwe, gifitaniye isano n’ibikorwa vya hormone bitangura mu mubiri wawe.
FirstPeriodComing.19: Ibisohoka mu gitsina biba bibonerana canke bisa n’umweru, bitanuka cane. Amaraso y’imihango, ho, ni umutuku kugeza ku wigeze kuba umukara, kandi yerekana intangiriro nyayo y’imihango yawe. Niba utabizi neza, kubivugako ntibigera biba ikibazo kinini.
FirstPeriodComing.21: Nta buryo bwo guhanura umusi nyawo. Guhorana ico wambaye ngo ukingire kuva ku bimenyetso vya mbere ni yo ngeso nziza.
FirstPeriodComing.22: Ukimara kubona ibyo bimenyetso, canke igihe cose ufise ikibazo canke impungenge, ushobora kuvugana na mama wawe, mushiki wawe, umuntu wo hafi yawe, canke umuganga wizeye. Nta gihe kidakwiriye co gusaba ubufasha.

FirstPeriodDailyLife.1:
Wokoresha ute imihango yawe
ya mbere buri musi?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.6: Hamwe n’ingeso nkeya zoroshe, imihango yawe ya mbere ihuza vyoroshe n’ubuzima bwawe bwa buri musi, ku ishure no hanze yaryo.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.10: Iyo imihango yawe ije ku buryo butateganijwe
FirstPeriodDailyLife.11: Ishure, siporo, ibitiro: imihango yawe ntikubuza gukomeza ibikorwa vyawe bisanzwe. Ukeneye gusa guhindura ingeso zimwezimwe kugira ugume woroherewe umusi wose.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.12: Ishure canke ibikorwa: bika igitambaro canke tampon mu gasakoshi kawe
FirstPeriodDailyLife.13: Siporo: ushobora gukomeza gukina, uhindura gusa umuvuduko
FirstPeriodDailyLife.14: Ibitiro: igitambaro gikwiye cyo ku ijoro kirahagije
FirstPeriodDailyLife.15: Agasakoshi gato karimwo igitambaro kimwe canke bibiri canke tampon, ishaki ry’imyambaro y’imbere n’impapuro zo guhanagura gashobora kuhira vyoroshe mu isakoshi y’ishure canke ya siporo. Gatuma wumva utuje uko vyoba vyifashe vyose.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.17: Guhorana igitambaro canke tampon bikurinda guhagarika umutima ko wokubitwa utiteguye.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.18: Ivyo bikunda, cane cane mu ntango. Umuforoma w’ishure, umwarimu, canke incuti hafi buri gihe bafise ikintu cashobora gufasha. Kuboha ikintu c’imyambaro mu rukenyerero na ko birashobora gufasha mu gihe urondera igitambaro canke tampon.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.20: Ni igitambaro canke tampon ikihe nahitamwo ku mihango yanje ya mbere?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.24: Imihango yanje ya mbere ntihamye: ni ibisanzwe?

FirstPeriodFaq.1:
Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa
ku mihango yawe ya mbere
FirstPeriodFaq.6: Ibisubizo vyoroshe ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa cane ku mihango yawe ya mbere.
FirstPeriodFaq.9: Ego. Ukwezi kwa mbere kunyuma akenshi kugira amaraso make. Amaraso ashobora gutandukana kuva ku kwezi ku kundi, cane cane mu ntango.
FirstPeriodFaq.11: Amaraso menshi na ko ashobora kubaho, cane cane mu minsi ibiri ya mbere. Niba ukeneye guhindura ico wambaye ngo ukingire karenga rimwe mu isaha mu masaha menshi akurikirana, ni vyiza kubivugako n’umuganga.
FirstPeriodFaq.13: Ububabare bworoshe mu nda y’epfo burakunda kandi ntibusanzwe buteye impungenge. Icupa ry’amazi ashushe canke akaruhuko gato birashobora gufasha. Ububabare bukomeye cane bukwiye kuvugwa ku muntu.
FirstPeriodFaq.15: Ego, ushobora gukomeza gukina siporo mu gihe c’imihango. Hindura gusa urugero rwayo bitewe n’uko umubiri wawe wiyumva uwo musi.
FirstPeriodFaq.17: Ego, ushobora gukomeza koga ufise ico ukingiye gikwiye. Abantu benshi bahitamwo gusa gutegereza kugeza igihe bumvise borohewe n’iyo ngingo.
FirstPeriodFaq.19: Nta kibazo gitera isoni kibaho: umubiri wose uratandukanye, kandi ushobora buri gihe kuvugana n’umuntu wizeye.
